job: Say which colour means which series.
purpose: A row of small swatches and muted labels. In a chart with data-legend it is a set of toggles: click a series to hide it and the scale adjusts; the last visible series cannot be turned off. To place one elsewhere, point a .fd-legend[data-for="#chart-id"] at the chart. Toggling fires fd:change.
useWhen: A chart has two or more series and readers need to know which is which.
A custom layout needs the legend away from the chart.
Series must be switchable on and off.

avoidWhen.when: A donut: its legend is part of it.

avoidWhen.instead: Name the series in the card title instead.

states.name: hidden series
states.how: aria-pressed="false" on the item; the series leaves the chart and fd:change fires

variants.useWhen: A line swatch with a faded fill for areas.

parts.role: One series; a button when it toggles.
